description: ADCOS Capability object: a signed, versioned statement describing something the node/adapter may provide. Required properties encode the frozen contains-list of spec/architecture.md §6.4. Advertisement, signing, negotiation, withdrawal, and provenance semantics are owned by WORK-005; the signature here is an opaque reference/value whose cryptographic profile is negotiated later (LOCK-015).

capability_id.description: Capability identifier; a registered entry of the capability registry, or a well-formed unknown future identifier (safely ignorable per architecture §2 P4).

evidence_references.description: References to evidence objects (adcos.evidence instances) supporting this advertisement (LOCK-008: claims carry provenance).

provider_identity.description: Identity reference of the provider making this statement.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this capability statement itself (MAJOR.MINOR).

signature.description: Opaque signature reference covering this statement; cryptographic profile owned by later Work Items (LOCK-014, LOCK-015).

validity.description: Validity interval of the statement; temporal semantics owned by WORK-005.

title: ADCOS Capability
